About Fairphone

Fairphone is more than just a company; we are a global leader in sustainable, modular electronics, on a mission to change the electronics industry from the inside out. At Fairphone, you will find a supportive and safe space where everyone can be themselves, collaborate openly, and have the freedom to learn and grow because that's how we innovate and drive change together!

So... are you a proactive, self-motivated team player who loves taking initiative and bringing positive energy? Do you thrive in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment? Are you a great communicator who values collaboration and embraces different perspectives? And most importantly, do you feel a strong connection to Fairphone's mission and values? If you're nodding along and thinking, "Yes, that's me!", then check out our vacancy below!

Please know that we acknowledge that we are living in a time where the use of AI can bring many efficiencies and support. However, we want to know the real YOU. Please try to limit the use of AI tools to generate answers to the application; we value authenticity and encourage you to use your creativity!

Location: Amsterdam (you must have the right to work in the Netherlands)
Hours: 32–40 hours per week
Start: 1st of the month
Contract duration: 1st 12-month employment contract with the possibility of extension to permanent
Deadline to apply: Rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible.

About Your Role

As our QA Automation Engineer , you will shape and elevate the quality culture across our web development team. Reporting to the Lead Developer, you will sit at the intersection of technical automation, release management, and critical analysis across our two Agile Scrum development teams.

This is not a traditional downstream testing role. You will shift quality "left" by critically questioning requirements, spotting edge cases, and embedding acceptance criteria into Jira tickets before a single line of code is written. Today, much of our QA work is handled manually by our UX Designers and Implementation Manager. You will lead our transition into a modern, automated QA environment while retaining the pragmatic mindset needed to manage structured manual test plans for ongoing deployments and, around 1–2 major launches a year.

You will establish our automated pre-deploy gates, create scheduled bug-detection scripts, and define clear severity rules. You need to empower our developers to take true ownership of their own unit and integration tests, serving as the authority who makes the final go/no-go call on deployments.

Key Responsibilities & Objectives

Your Key Responsibilities

Automation Architecture & Ownership: Plan, build, and maintain our end-to-end test automation suites using Playwright with Python.
CI/CD Quality Gates: Integrate automated testing into GitHub Actions to create automated pre-deployment quality gates and run weekly automated bug-detection scripts across our webshop.
Refinement & Critical Analysis: Partner with Product Owners and UX Designers during Jira refinement sessions to define rigorous acceptance criteria, edge-case scenarios, as well as non-functional requirements.
Release & Bug Governance: Establish bug severity rules, manage staging environment improvements, and hold ultimate accountability for the go/no-go release decisions.
Manual Release Planning: Design and execute structured manual test plans, ensuring cross-device and -browser compatibility, usability, and performance. For frontend as well as for APIs and backend.
Enforce Quality Standards & Developer Accountability: Establish firm quality guardrails and hold developers accountable for their code's baseline quality. You will persistently challenge user stories, pull requests, and test coverage to ensure teams strictly adhere to quality rules before any increment moves to production.
Process Advice: Provide active input on refining our team's Definition of Done and improving our staging environment infrastructure alongside the Lead Developer and Product Owners.

Key Objectives

Build the Automation Foundation: Establish an automated CI/CD pre-deploy quality gate in GitHub Actions using Playwright (Python bindings) to safeguard our storefront and backend logic.
Embed Shift-Left Quality: Actively participate in Jira refinements, applying extreme critical thinking to identify technical edge cases and acceptance criteria before development begins.
Guide the QA Transition: Balance immediate needs (~30% manual test planning & release strategy) with long-term goals (~70% test automation setup and developer coaching).
Elevate Increment Quality: Take ownership of improving the overall quality of software increments shipped to production, driving a continuous reduction in post-release bugs and regression defects.

Your Skills & Experience

Minimum 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance with a focus on web application test automation.
Hands-on experience setting up automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright (Python bindings preferred) or Cypress.
Practical experience configuring automated quality pipelines within CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
Experience with, or an eagerness to explore and adopt, AI-assisted testing and development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI test generation tools) to accelerate test coverage, script maintenance, and bug detection.
Strong background in Agile Scrum environments, with proven success driving critical thinking, edge-case discovery, and acceptance criteria writing during user story refinement.
Solid understanding of web architectures and e-commerce platforms (experience with Python-based backends or platforms like Odoo is an advantage).
Ability to balance automated suite development with hands-on manual test strategy for major commercial releases.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable handling various projects at the same time, coaching team members and driving process improvements.

What Fairphone can offer you?

The opportunity to create an impact on the electronics industry around the world.
A diverse work environment full of international, passionate, warm-hearted team members.
25 paid holidays per year (based on a full-time contract) next to the other public holidays in the Netherlands. You’ll also get a day off on your birthday! Additionally, the longer you stay, the more holidays you get! 
Daily, healthy lunch, organic FairChain coffee, and many more tasty things.
You will join Fairphone’s collective pension scheme, and we will contribute to building your pension.
You will receive a MacBook, Fairbuds, and a Fairphone as working devices.
Hybrid working model: We are remote-friendly and also contribute up to €250 toward your home office set-up.
Public transport allowance – we fully cover your 2nd-class commute from your home to the office
Bike allowance – We support you with a bike purchase of up to €300, and you’ll also have a yearly repair budget of up to €100! We also cover 23 cents per km for your biking distance from home to the office (or train station) and back!
Grow with us! We encourage you to develop at Fairphone. In addition to €500 for L&D, we’ll support your career goals with coaching (Inuka), workshops, or courses that you can join with your development budget. You will get access to Udemy with unlimited courses and trainings.
Kitchen with beautiful views to the IJ waterfront.
There’s a gym in the building where you can build healthy habits, stay active and have fun with your colleagues, as well as a subscription to our mental & physical well-being services (Inuka & Urban Sports)

Job Description

At Lely, software plays a crucial role in the performance, reliability, and safety of our robotic and farm management solutions. Every day, our products help dairy farmers around the world work more efficiently while improving animal welfare and supporting sustainable food production.

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you help shape the quality engineering and test automation strategy for Horizon, Lely's farm management platform. You provide technical direction, drive improvements across multiple teams, and help elevate the maturity of our testing practices. Your focus goes beyond building and maintaining automated tests; you create the conditions that enable teams to deliver high-quality software with confidence.

You take ownership of strategic quality initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and help teams make informed decisions based on objective quality data. You play a leading role in advancing our automation approach across multiple test levels, including component, API, and end-to-end testing. This includes further developing our component testing capabilities, designing, implementing, and maintaining the underlying test infrastructure, such as CI/CD test pipelines, test execution environments, and CI/CD runners. You drive continuous improvements to the test platform, ensuring fast, reliable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle and enabling teams to deliver high-quality software with confidence.

As a senior member of the Test Automation Chapter, you help define standards, share best practices, coach fellow engineers, and contribute to the long-term direction of test automation within Digital Farming. Many improvements extend beyond a single development team, requiring you to build alignment and collaborate effectively with stakeholders and engineering teams in the Netherlands, Turkey and Portugal.

Alongside these chapter-wide responsibilities, you are also part of a Scrum team, where you contribute hands-on to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests and quality practices within Horizon.

The work is carried out primarily from our campus in Maassluis. Occasional travel to Turkey is expected to support collaboration and successful implementation of improvements across teams.

Your main responsibilities include:

Defining and evolving the test automation strategy across component, API, and end-to-end testing. 
Leading quality improvement initiatives and driving adoption across multiple teams. 
Providing technical direction and coaching to fellow test automation engineers within the Test Automation Chapter. 
Taking ownership of the component testing domain, including defining the approach, expanding component test coverage, and integrating it into the CI/CD pipeline. 
Driving collaboration between testing, software development, architecture, and other technical disciplines across the Netherlands and Turkey. 
Providing objective insights on product quality, risk, and release readiness.

Designing, implementing, and maintaining automated E2E and API tests using TypeScript and Playwright. 
Designing, implementing, and maintaining component tests using C# and Testcontainers. 
Supporting the migration from Cucumber to Playwright. 
Managing and improving CI/CD test pipelines in GitLab. 
Owning the automated quality gates that determine merge readiness. 
Managing the Windows VM test lab and associated infrastructure. 
Maintaining dashboards, reporting pipelines, and quality metrics. 
Maintaining the supporting tooling and scripts used for test execution and infrastructure automation in PowerShell, Python, Azure, Windows, and Kubernetes environments. 

Qualifications

You are a people-oriented senior engineer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for product quality. You enjoy helping engineers grow, bringing teams together, and creating clarity in complex development environments.

In addition, you bring:

A bachelor's or master's degree in Software Engineering or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent working and thinking ability. 
AT least 5 years of experience in test automation, verification, or quality engineering within a technical product development environment. 
Experience guiding, coaching, or mentoring engineers in technical initiatives. 
A broad technical interest and affinity with multidisciplinary systems, software, and robotics. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment across different teams and disciplines. 
Fluency in English.

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.

Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant. 

Work-life balance

A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00). 
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.

Job Description:
Digital Support Experience Specialist

Location: Amsterdam (Hybrid) | Hours: 40 hrs | Contract: 6 Months | Language: English


About the Role

For one of our international partners within the Fintech industry, we're looking for a Digital Support Experience specialist to help transform the way business partners access support and guidance across digital channels.
In this role, you will focus on creating seamless self-service experiences that enable users to quickly find answers, complete operational tasks, and resolve issues independently. By combining data, customer insights, content strategy, personalization, and AI-powered solutions, you'll play a key role in reducing friction across critical user journeys.
Working with cross-functional teams across Product, Customer Support, Analytics, Content, and Marketing Technology, you'll identify opportunities to improve digital experiences and deliver scalable solutions that increase customer satisfaction while reducing support effort.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex experience challenges through data-driven decision making, experimentation, and emerging technologies.


What You'll Do



Improve Digital Support Experiences

Analyze user behavior, support trends, search performance, and feedback to identify friction points across digital support journeys.
Use insights to prioritize initiatives that improve self-service success and reduce the need for assisted support.
Recommend and implement scalable solutions that help users resolve issues more efficiently.

Drive Self-Service and Knowledge Optimization

Define improvements across knowledge bases, help centers, support journeys, and digital guidance experiences.
Develop strategic recommendations and briefs that improve findability, usability, and task completion.
Collaborate with content specialists to ensure support resources align with user needs and business priorities.

Optimize AI-Powered Support

Partner with product and experience teams to improve the quality of AI-driven support experiences.
Evaluate conversational performance and identify opportunities to enhance response relevance, accuracy, and resolution rates.
Use customer insights and performance metrics to optimize knowledge inputs and support workflows.

Deliver Personalized Support Journeys

Design and execute targeted communications through web experiences, in-product messaging, and email campaigns.
Deliver contextual guidance based on user behavior and business needs.
Test proactive interventions that help prevent issues before support is needed.

Experiment and Validate

Develop hypotheses and run experiments to measure the effectiveness of support content, messaging, and user journeys.
Conduct A/B testing to evaluate improvements and generate actionable recommendations.
Establish meaningful success metrics and monitor performance over time.

Manage Projects and Stakeholders

Lead initiatives from concept through implementation.
Coordinate priorities across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Ensure projects are delivered on time and generate measurable outcomes.

What You'll Bring

3-5 years of experience in Digital Support, Customer Experience, Self-Service, Knowledge Management, Customer Success, or related digital experience functions.
Experience working with help centers, knowledge bases, service portals, chatbot environments, or customer support ecosystems.
Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to convert data and feedback into actionable insights.
Experience working with customer journey optimization, digital experience improvements, or self-service strategies.
Understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), conversational AI, and knowledge management frameworks.
Hands-on experience with testing, experimentation, and performance measurement.
Strong stakeholder management and project coordination skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
